scripts.clean:runtime: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:tests: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:web
scripts.build:runtime: npm run clean:runtime && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && node scripts/write-agent-result-schema.mjs
scripts.verify:fast: npm run build:runtime:fast 1>&2 || exit 1 && node build/server/agents/verify/main.js fast
scripts.verify:area: npm run build:runtime:fast 1>&2 || exit 1 && node build/server/agents/verify/main.js area
scripts.verify:full: npm run build:runtime:fast 1>&2 || exit 1 && node build/server/agents/verify/main.js full
scripts.test:tooling: npm run build:runtime && npm run test:tooling:nobuild
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build:runtime && npm run test:runtime:nobuild
scripts.test:runtime:nobuild: npm run clean:tests && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".test-dist/tests/server/**/*.test.js" ".test-dist/tests/shared/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:container: npm run build:agent-image && npm run clean:tests && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 ".test-dist/tests/container/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:all: npm run format:check && npm run build:runtime && npm run test:web && npm run test:tooling:nobuild && npm run test:runtime:nobuild
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:runtime && npm run typecheck:e2e
